title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Billing Rules: Calibration, Sublet, Diagnostic Charges and Transfers to Claim Repairs
content:
## Billing rules

1. Charges on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order post on the completion date.
2. An in-house calibration posts a calibration charge of the tier's calibration price. — This rule is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis on which the calibration charge is posted.
3. A sublet posts a **dealer sublet** charge instead. On an insurance claim repair or a glass program order it is the dealer invoice plus the tier's dealer sublet handling percentage of that invoice, the total rounded to the cent. On a customer-pay order, where the tier caps customer-pay sublets, the charge is the dealer invoice plus handling, and the part above the tier's calibration price is written off as a sublet cap write-off.
4. Alignment charges follow the precheck rules.
5. A customer-requested order cancelled because the diagnosis found no calibration need posts a diagnostic charge of the tier's standalone diagnostic fee.
6. A warranty rework order posts no charge at all.
7. Every charge of an insurance claim repair order is transferred on the same day onto that repair order, naming the supplement that approved the calibration (0 when it was on the original estimate). The insurer pays it through the repair order, never on the calibration order.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

**Sublet on an insurance claim repair.** Dealer invoice 512.40 USD; handling percentage 10. Handling is 10 percent of 512.40, that is 51.24; the dealer sublet charge is 512.40 plus 51.24, which is 563.64 USD. The same day, the 563.64 is transferred onto the insurance claim repair order, naming the approving supplement (or 0 if the calibration was on the original estimate).

**Sublet on a customer-pay order with the cap.** Dealer invoice 400.00 USD; handling percentage 10; calibration price of the tier 349.00 USD. The dealer sublet charge is 400.00 plus 40.00, which is 440.00 USD. The part above the calibration price, 440.00 less 349.00, that is 91.00 USD, is written off as a sublet cap write-off, leaving 349.00 USD owed.

## Charge by order situation

| Order situation | Charge posted |
|---|---|
| Sublet, insurance claim repair or glass program | Dealer sublet: invoice plus handling, rounded to the cent |
| Sublet, customer-pay, capped tier | Dealer sublet: invoice plus handling; the part above the calibration price written off as sublet cap |
| Customer request cancelled, no calibration needed | Diagnostic charge of the standalone diagnostic fee |
| Warranty rework | None |

superseded_clauses: An in-house calibration posts a calibration charge of calibration_price_usd.
